# Reference values from Otava and Mylona (2020)

`paper_reference.csv` holds every cell of all 14 heatmaps in the code
supplement of Otava, M. and Mylona, K. (2020), *Quality and Reliability
Engineering International* 36(8), 2688-2698, doi:10.1002/qre.2697 (seven per case study: main effects only, main + quadratic, signed
MPI, signed Eq. 5, |MPI| Eq. 5 = Figures 1/3, factor subset = Figure 4 for the
simulated study, x3 range restriction = Figure 2 for the pastry study),
**computed by the article's own `heatmapVisualization()`**, not by herminR.

It is regenerated by `data-raw/paper_reference.R` from the supplement
(`data-raw/paper_supplement/`), and `tests/testthat/test-paper-reference.R`
checks herminR against it cell by cell.
